title: Skip links and landmarks

title: Keyboard-only operation and focus order
procedure: Tab/Shift+Tab through primary controls, open and close menus
expected: Every action reachable; order meaningful; no traps

title: Focus visible and not obscured
procedure: Navigate sticky header, drawer, sheet and modal while scrolled
expected: Focus distinctly visible, not fully obscured, restored after close

title: Combobox search and selection
procedure: Enter query, use arrows, choose item, clear, Escape
expected: Roles and active selection announced; no focus loss

title: Radio, checkbox and switch states
procedure: Navigate options and change each type
expected: Names/states and disabled explanations perceived

title: Date and date-range picker
procedure: Open calendar, choose and revise dates, repair invalid range
expected: Calendar keyboard operation and errors perceived

title: Modal dialog and sheet focus lifecycle
procedure: Open, Tab cycle, Escape/Cancel, confirm, return
expected: Modal containment only when modal; correct initial/return focus

title: Carousel and pagination
procedure: Move previous/next using labelled controls and keyboard
expected: Position announced; no auto-advance obstruction

title: Slider and drag alternatives
procedure: Adjust with arrows/direct value; complete without drag
expected: Equivalent alternative to drag; no gesture-only completion

title: Loading, progress and status messages
procedure: Trigger loading, success, failure and retry
expected: Relevant status announced without stealing focus; progress understandable

title: Validation and error recovery
procedure: Submit blank/invalid form, locate error, correct and resubmit
expected: Error identified/described; input preserved; clear recovery

title: Upload and upload-failure recovery
procedure: Choose synthetic file, wait, interrupt/retry/remove
expected: Selection/upload status accessible; no data loss or ambiguous completion

title: Opaque contrast and all palette roles

title: Actual glass compositing
procedure: Read real content over simple and complex image under glass and opaque
expected: Effective text/focus contrast preserved or opaque fallback

title: Text resizing/reflow
procedure: Inspect 200% text and 400% zoom/reflow and small viewport
expected: No loss of information/function or two-dimensional scroll except allowed

title: Reduced motion/transparency
procedure: Disable motion, reduce transparency, verify interactions
expected: Meaning and immediate commands preserved without expressive motion

title: Forced colours/high contrast
procedure: Use Windows forced colours, inspect icons, focus, buttons, surfaces
expected: Status/actions identifiable without color alone; outline visible

title: Outline/Filled/Colour/Duotone icon meaning
procedure: Review icon-only actions at 16/24px and all 4 styles
expected: Accessible label available; no meaning conveyed only by colour

title: Language, reading order, cognitive clarity
procedure: Change language if applicable, read form and instructions with AT
expected: Correct page/part language, helpful instructions and logical sequence

expected: Actions and state changes announced; workflow completable
